title: Hide the live catalog badge when catalog loading fails
prompt:
Prevent the landing-page live badge from treating API failures as an empty healthy catalog. Evidence: src/components/BazaarStatus.tsx:8-13 parses every HTTP response without checking ok and substitutes zero when tools is missing. Lines 20-24 then display a green live indicator. A local mocked HTTP 500 with {error:true} rendered "0 tools live from 0 providers" from the actual component.

Change only src/components/BazaarStatus.tsx in production. Check HTTP success before parsing and require an array-valued tools payload before calculating the existing counts. On HTTP failure, malformed JSON, missing or non-array tools, or rejected fetch, leave the badge hidden through the existing null state. Preserve successful nonempty counts, unique-provider counting, singular/plural wording, and the valid empty-array behavior. Keep this focused on load failures; do not redesign pagination or global catalog metrics.

Add tests/bazaar-status-http-errors.test.mjs. Transpile the component and mock hooks/fetch as the existing UI tests do, then render after each asynchronous response. Cover HTTP 500 even with a tools array, invalid JSON, malformed payload, network rejection, empty success, and two tools sharing one provider. Run node --test tests/bazaar-status-http-errors.test.mjs tests/providers-search-null-description.test.mjs. Open PR #23 changes the marketplace page, not this component. work on the assigned branch you are on. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflow, package.json, or auth changes.
